titles.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman Movie: Baikinman to Ehon no Lulun
えいがそれいけ! アンパンマン ばいきんまんとえほんのルルン

data.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman Movie: Baikinman to Ehon no Lulun
data.title_japanese: えいがそれいけ! アンパンマン ばいきんまんとえほんのルルン
data.synopsis:
One day, Baikinman finds a picture book. He hears a voice from the book saying, "Baikinman, warrior of love and courage, come and save me!" and is sucked into the book. He meets Lulun, a forest fairy, in a large forest beyond the desert. Lulun is scared and can't muster up her courage, so she asks Baikinman to defeat the "Sucking Elephant" that is rampaging through the forest. Although she is reluctant at first, Lulun is inspired by Baikinman's refusal to give up and stand up to her. However, she has a hard time with the strength of the Sucking Elephant! In a desperate situation, Baikinman tells Lulun, "Call Anpanman!" Anpanman and Baikinman join forces and do great things! 

(Source: Official Site, translated)

titles.title: Luka and the Flower of the Sun

data.title: Luka to Taiyou no Hana
data.title_english: Luka and the Flower of the Sun
data.synopsis:
A story set in a village covered with clouds depicting the bond between a young boy, Luka, and his childhood friend, Rosa. One day Rosa, who has the power of the sun, hears from a mysterious duo named Kiyu and Orico that there is a way to clear the clouds. Meanwhile, Luka is attracted to a traveling band that visits the village, and decides to leave the village.

(Source: NHK, translated)

titles.title: ゴー！ゴー！びーくるずー

data.title: Go! Go! Vehicle Zoo (2024)
data.title_japanese: ゴー！ゴー！びーくるずー
data.synopsis: Follow-up to the original Go! Go! Vehicle Zoo. This series is more of the same, but introduces a couple new characters. There's the newest Vehicle Zoo pair, a dog named Moko who specializes in tracking, and her partner, a fire truck named Fine. And there's also Guutan, a chaotic unidentified creature who's the closest thing this show has to a villain. He's a lot of fun.
data.background: This season, with episodes a bit longer than the TV series, streamed exclusively on Takara Tomy's Youtube channel.
